text:
jamie: capacity-bot alert just fired for hosted-eu2 -> p95 queueing for gpu-pool 'hosted-eu2-gpus' at 2.6s, admission throttling increased to 18% :warning:
capacity-bot: [ALERT] hosted-eu2-gpus p95_queueing=2.6s p50=0.9s admission_reject_rate=0.18 source=embed-service

puneet: copying dashboards now, on it. do we know if it's a traffic spike or slowdown?

jamie: looks like embed-service is the top contributor, sudden uptick in short embedding requests. infra-sre graph: inflight spikes ~3x in last 6m, qlen climbs steady.

matt: @puneet @jamie can we toggle overflow routing to dedicated pool temporarily? also check KV cache hitrate for embeddings (cold starts make inference slower).

tara: quick checks:
```
# last 10m aggregation
service=embed-service inflight: 120 -> 380
hosted-eu2-gpus qlen: 10 -> 72
kvcache_hit_rate: 0.23 -> 0.12
```

sylvia: KVCACHE looks cold (deploy earlier cleared prefixes). embed requests are short but high qps -> more expensive per-token due to small batches.

jamie: plan suggestion: 1) enable overflow to dedicated-eu2-reserve for embeddings 2) raise autoscaler target by +15% for next 30m 3) temporarily increase admission soft limits for non-interactive routes 4) kick a refill job for 2 racks. anyone object?

puneet: +1 to overflow and refill. need a rollback plan in 10m if latency doesn't improve.

infra-sre: initiated routing change: 
```
/ops route-set --pool hosted-eu2-gpus --overflow dedicated-eu2-reserve --routes embed-service
status: rolling, expected completion ~30s
```

oncall-bot: Routing change completed (id=chg-2003). monitor dashboards for 5m.

matt: autoscaler bump applied (target 0.75 -> 0.86), will auto-revert in 30m unless we pin.

tara: refill job enqueued: INF-7623 (refill 2 racks in eu-west-2), ETA 12m.

puneet: after overflow + autoscale: p95 queueing down to 1.4s, admission_reject_rate -> 4%. kvcache hitrate climbing (now 0.34).

jamie: nice — keep an eye on cost delta, overflow to dedicated will bill differently. tagging finance for post-mortem. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sylvia: logging follow-up ticket for root cause: why did KV cache clear? looks like a config rollout earlier. INF-7624 created with links to rollout job.

matt: next steps: 1) revert temporary routing if stable for 20m 2) schedule an eval job to test small-batch embedding patterns and recommend batching windows 3) review rollout process that cleared cache. thanks all.

jamie: thanks team — marking thread resolved once p95 < 1s for 30m. :white_check_mark:
